purpose: Authored synthetic ground truth, independent of the index. Each entry defines behavior and two paraphrased questions; generated source and queries are frozen by manifest hash before evaluation.
entries: SessionPolicy
Determines whether a login session has expired by comparing the current time with its expiration timestamp.
Where is the lifetime of a signed-in session checked?
Onde verifica se a sessão do usuário já venceu?
TokenService
Issues authentication tokens containing a subject, issuance time and expiration time.
Which code creates credentials with a user identity and expiry?
Qual código emite credenciais com identidade e validade?
LoginPolicy
Rejects repeated authentication failures after the account reaches its attempt limit.
Where does the account stop accepting failed sign-in attempts?
Onde bloqueia novas tentativas depois de várias senhas erradas?
InvoiceTotal
Calculates a billing total by summing line items, applying a discount and rounding the final amount.
How is the discounted amount payable computed?
Onde calcula o valor a pagar depois do desconto?
StatusBadge
Renders a colored status indicator for running, failed and completed background tasks.
Which component shows whether background work succeeded?
Qual componente mostra sucesso ou falha do trabalho em segundo plano?
ProjectIndex
Scans project source files and extracts declarations into a searchable structural database.
Where does source code become searchable symbols?
Onde transforma código do projeto em símbolos pesquisáveis?
DirtyQueue
Persists changed file paths and acknowledges only the matching version after successful processing.
How are pending file edits retained when processing fails?
Como preserva alterações pendentes quando o processamento falha?
StructuralRevision
Advances a project revision within the same transaction that changes indexed source records.
Where is the freshness counter committed with index updates?
Onde confirma a revisão junto com a atualização do índice?
SemanticCache
Keys cached retrieval results by embedding generation and structural revision to prevent stale answers.
How are obsolete search answers excluded after an index change?
Como evita respostas antigas de busca após mudanças no índice?
PathCandidates
Uses prefix and trigram candidates to find project file paths without scanning the entire file table.
Where are incomplete filenames matched efficiently?
Onde encontra nomes incompletos de arquivos sem varrer tudo?
SymbolLookup
Locates a named function or class declaration and returns its source file and line range.
How can a declaration be found from its identifier?
Como localiza a declaração pelo identificador?
CallerGraph
Follows reference edges to find the functions that invoke a selected function.
Where can I find who calls this function?
Onde encontro quem chama esta função?
ToolDiscovery
Ranks available tools by names, descriptions and parameter aliases in English and Portuguese.
How does an agent find the right capability for a request?
Como o agente encontra a capacidade adequada ao pedido?
ToolProjection
Confirms tool visibility only from schemas actually sent in the next model request.
Where is activation verified against the outgoing model payload?
Onde confirma a ativação pelo conteúdo enviado ao modelo?
McpCatalog
Traverses all remote capability listing pages and rejects repeated cursors and conflicting names.
How are paginated remote tool listings collected safely?
Como reúne todas as páginas de ferramentas remotas?
McpRefresh
Refreshes one remote server connection without interrupting operations on unrelated servers.
Where is reconnect isolated to the affected integration?
Onde a reconexão afeta somente a integração que mudou?
McpResult
Preserves structured JSON data and image content blocks returned by a remote tool.
Where are remote tool objects and pictures kept intact?
Onde preserva objetos e imagens retornados por ferramentas remotas?
InvocationOwner
Binds each tool invocation to its session, run, attempt and parent invocation.
How is a nested operation linked to the owning execution?
Como liga uma operação aninhada à execução responsável?
CommandSpec
Separates an executable and literal argument array from explicit shell source text.
Where can a process receive arguments without shell interpolation?
Onde passa argumentos literais sem interpretação do shell?
ProcessOutput
Stores process stdout and stderr in a bounded spool with signed continuation cursors.
How can a long command log be read in later pages?
Como recupera páginas seguintes de um log longo?
ProcessCleanup
Terminates owned child process trees and drains final output before reporting completion.
Where are grandchildren stopped and final log lines collected?
Onde encerra processos descendentes e coleta as últimas linhas?
SqlClassifier
Classifies SQL statements conservatively and detects hidden writes inside common table expressions.
Where are mutations concealed in a WITH query detected?
Onde detecta escrita escondida dentro de uma consulta WITH?
PoolLease
Keeps database connections leased until operations finish and drains an old pool before retirement.
How are active queries protected during pool replacement?
Como protege consultas ativas durante troca do pool?
QueryDeadline
Applies one absolute deadline across connection acquisition and all statements in an operation.
Where does waiting for a connection consume the query time allowance?
Onde o tempo de espera pela conexão conta no prazo da consulta?
RowWindow
Limits retained query rows, total bytes and individual cell size during acquisition.
How is memory bounded while fetching a huge result set?
Como limita memória durante a leitura de muitos resultados?
CatalogPage
Lists database tables in incremental pages without introspecting every column of every table.
Where does the schema browser fetch table names progressively?
Onde o navegador de banco carrega nomes de tabelas por partes?
OptimisticEdit
Updates a row only if its primary key and original values still match, otherwise reports a conflict.
How does editing detect changes made by another client?
Como a edição detecta alterações feitas por outro cliente?
ExportKeyset
Exports table rows using a composite primary key cursor rather than unstable numeric offsets.
Where is table export ordered across multiple primary key columns?
Onde a exportação mantém ordem por chave primária composta?
ImportReceipt
Records the terminal outcome of a database import and forbids replay after an uncertain commit.
How is a database restore prevented from running twice after disconnect?
Como evita repetir uma restauração após perder a conexão?
ConnectionScope
Identifies a database connection using project, connection identifier and selected database together.
Where are same-named database connections from different projects separated?
Onde separa conexões com mesmo nome em projetos diferentes?
UnicodeOutput
Decodes UTF-8 process output incrementally while preserving emoji split between byte chunks.
How are split multibyte characters kept intact in logs?
Como preserva caracteres que chegam divididos no log?
CursorSignature
Signs pagination cursors with an owner-scoped secret and rejects tampered or expired tokens.
Where are modified continuation tokens rejected?
Onde rejeita tokens de paginação adulterados?
RetryPolicy
Retries safe reads with capped exponential backoff and refuses automatic retry of unknown mutations.
How is waiting between safe retry attempts bounded?
Como limita a espera entre tentativas seguras?
CapabilitySchema
Validates tool input schemas and enforces adapter-attested limits before provider dispatch.
Where are incompatible tool definitions rejected before inference?
Onde rejeita definições incompatíveis antes da inferência?
Cancellation
Propagates an abort request to physical work and distinguishes cancellation acceptance from termination.
How does stop wait for the actual operation to finish?
Como o cancelamento aguarda o encerramento real?
MigrationJournal
Records completed local schema migrations so restarting does not reapply an already committed migration.
Where is database upgrade progress retained across restarts?
Onde preserva o progresso da atualização do banco após reiniciar?
WorkspacePath
Resolves project-relative paths and rejects traversal outside the authorized workspace root.
How are file requests confined to the permitted project?
Como mantém acesso a arquivos dentro do projeto permitido?
QueryHistory
Keeps recent SQL execution summaries with duration and success status for later inspection.
Where can previous database executions be reviewed?
Onde revisa execuções anteriores de consultas no banco?
ReadOnlyGuard
Rejects SQL operations that can change data when the connection is configured for reading only.
How does a read-only connection block destructive statements?
Como uma conexão de leitura impede comandos destrutivos?
GenerationSwap
Publishes a prepared index generation atomically and retains the previous generation after a failed build.
Where does a failed rebuild leave the last good index usable?
Onde uma reconstrução com falha preserva o índice anterior?
